_comment: T-L6-E AC-6 / ADR-013 — minimal stylelint config that asserts ONLY the design-token rules (no hardcoded hex / rgba / hsl / gradient, no direct box-shadow). Used by `npm run check:stylelint` and the dedicated `stylelint-tokens` CI gate. The full standard ruleset (declaration-block-no-redundant-longhand-properties, no-descending-specificity, etc.) is exercised separately by `npm run lint:css` inside the unit-tests CI job; that surface owns the broader stylistic linting and is allowed to flag pre-existing tech debt without blocking the ADR-013 gate.

color-no-hex.message: Hardcoded hex colors are forbidden — use theme tokens (ADR-013)

function-disallowed-list.message: rgba()/rgb()/hsl()/gradient() are forbidden — use theme tokens (ADR-013)

property-disallowed-list.message: Direct box-shadow is forbidden — use theme shadow tokens (ADR-013)
